headlines.title: Israel orders full West Bank lockdown after deadly shooting attack
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered the Israel Defense Forces to impose a closure of the city of Hebron and also told them to prepare for a "full lockdown" of the occupied West Bank. NBC News' Claudio Lavanga reports the latest on the situation.

headlines.title: Meghan Markle Speaks Out About Accusations Against Her Father
headlines.description: Meghan Markle, the Duchess of Sussex, is responding to reports her father is under investigation in the Philippines for alleged possession of child abuse materials. "My sincerest hope is that justice will be fully served and that the priority remains the safety and protection of innocent children," she said in a statement. NBC’s Daniele Hamamdjian reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Russian diesel tanker heads to the U.S., the first since Trump’s deal with Putin
headlines.description: A tanker loaded with diesel fuel set sail Friday from Russia for the United States, the first shipment since President Donald Trump agreed a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to release more fuel into the global market.

headlines.title: New York AG James files opposition to effort to bar her from Cornell investigation
headlines.description: One of the men named in an explosive lawsuit alleging sexual assault at a Cornell fraternity house opposed Letitia James’ appointment as special prosecutor.

headlines.title: World Series set to start as potential MLB lockout or strike looms for next season
headlines.description: With the World Series starting soon, owners and players will head to the negotiating table to figure out the next collective bargaining agreement. If neither side can come to an agreement, the 2027 season may be in jeopardy. NBC News' Steven Romo reports.

headlines.title: Trump hopes to flatter Putin into negotiating on Ukraine
headlines.description: A Trump diplomat called Putin “a humanitarian,” another in a recent flurry of overtures to the Russian leader. But it’s unclear whether blandishments will entice him to strike a deal.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Meghan Markle ‘deeply distressed’ by allegations her dad possessed child sexual abuse images
headlines.description: Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, said Friday that she was “deeply distressed” by allegations that her dad Thomas Markle possessed child sexual abuse images.

headlines.title: One person killed in shooting near Paris, French prime minister says
headlines.description: At least one person was killed and four people were injured in a shooting near Paris, French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said Friday.

headlines.title: Kimi Antonelli can make F1 history in Texas as the youngest-ever champion. Here’s how.
headlines.description: The 20-year-old Italian prodigy has had a breakout 2026 season for Mercedes after he struggled as a rookie last year.

headlines.title: With MLB lockout looming, World Series readies for two small-market teams
headlines.description: For all the concerns about payroll disparity in MLB headed into the season, this World Series features two of the lowest-spending teams in the sport when the Milwaukee Brewers face the Tampa Bay Rays.
